report.title: Live2D model incomplete
report.leadBlocked: “{{name}}” was not uploaded. Its manifest references files that were not in the folder, and without them there is nothing to render.
report.leadWarning: “{{name}}” was uploaded and will render, but its manifest references files that were not in the folder.
report.requiredHint: Upload the model again with these files at exactly these paths. Live2D bundles keep textures and motions in subfolders — uploading a flattened copy is the usual cause.
report.optionalHint: The model renders without these. Motions and expressions it cannot find simply will not be available.
report.malformedHint: The manifest itself is broken, so supplying files will not help. Re-export the model from Cubism, or download it again.

supply.title: Supply the missing files
supply.hint: Drop the missing files here, or pick them. The files you already chose are kept — you only need to add what is listed above. Matching is by file name, so you do not have to recreate the folders.
supply.chooseSourceOption: {{count}} possible matches in this folder — choose one
supply.relocatedNote: vspark found {{count}} of the missing file(s) elsewhere in what you uploaded, and has filled them in above — each row shows where it was found. Check them, remove any that look wrong, then upload.

picker.title: Which model?
picker.lead: “{{name}}” contains {{count}} Live2D models. vspark uploads one model at a time — choose the one you want.
